def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Select the central uniform column as the divider; other uniform
    # columns may simply be part of a panel's pattern.
    candidates = [c for c in range(w)
                  if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    sep = min(candidates, key=lambda c: abs(c - w // 2))

    left = [row[:sep] for row in grid]
    right = [row[sep + 1:] for row in grid]
    left_values = [v for row in left for v in row]
    left_bg = max(set(left_values), key=left_values.count)
    right_values = [v for row in right for v in row]
    right_bg = max(set(right_values), key=right_values.count)

    return [[3 if left[r][c] != left_bg else right_bg
             for c in range(len(right[0]))]
            for r in range(h)]

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # The uniform full-height stripe divides the source pattern from
    # the panel whose background color is retained.
    sep = next(c for c in range(w)
               if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1)
    left = [row[:sep] for row in grid]
    right = [row[sep + 1:] for row in grid]

    # Map the source's non-background cells to 3 over the right panel's
    # most common color.
    from collections import Counter
    source_bg = Counter(v for row in left for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    output_bg = Counter(v for row in right for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    return [[3 if left[r][c] != source_bg else output_bg
             for c in range(len(right[0]))] for r in range(h)]
